generation.initialPrompt:
Create ONE game-ready-layout transparent sprite atlas for the next batch of ModWorld original pixel-art enemies.
Image1 is the approved STYLE REFERENCE only: match its chunky readable native pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, compact proportions, muted fantasy palette, shading and small sprite scale. Do NOT draw a goblin in the output. Image2 is SPECIES IDENTITY REFERENCE only; reinterpret it in image1's pixel art style, not its painted texture.
Use exactly 8 columns and 5 rows, all 40 cells occupied, consistent size and camera. Canvas about 1600x1000, with each equal cell about 200x200. Draw sprites directly as native pixel art. Flat limited value groups, hard alpha edges, no anti-aliasing, blur or painterly gradients. Leave generous fully transparent margins around each COMPLETE silhouette including paws/tails/legs/vapor. Each pose must be isolated: a continuous fully transparent horizontal and vertical gap between every neighboring sprite. No body, weapon or particle may cross into another cell. Do not trim the outer canvas. Fixed elevated three-quarter isometric game camera and upper-left light.
EXACT ORDER:
Row0: eight idle facings in order south, south-east, east, north-east, north, north-west, west, south-west.
Row1: EAST locomotion4 then WEST locomotion4.
Row2: EAST attack4 (anticipation, windup, impact, recovery) then WEST attack4.
Row3: EAST hit4 (flinch, strongest recoil, regaining control, ready) then WEST hit4.
Row4: EAST death4 (start, falling/collapsing, landed/dissipating, final still remains) then WEST death4.
Each state's four frames show real changed anatomy/pose, not translated copies. Keep identity, scale and projection fixed. No backdrop, ground, shadow, platform, UI, grid, separators, captions, lettering, watermark, checkerboard or decorative effects. Return ONLY the transparent atlas.

SPECIES: Original gray-brown forest WOLF, a low muscular four-legged animal with pointed ears, long narrow muzzle, pale cheek/muzzle fur, scarred brow, yellow eyes, bushy tail and four visible paws. No clothing, weapons, armor, wings or human hands. Long horizontal silhouette roughly 130-150px wide and 80-100px high in its cell. Ground root local x100 y170; paw-contact height stays fixed for upright poses.
LOCOMOTION: four-frame quadruped trot with diagonal leg pairs alternating, shoulders/hips flexing and tail following, no bipedal steps or bouncing root.
ATTACK: draws head back, crouches and bares fangs, short forward bite with jaw wide at impact, recovers. Whole muzzle and tail fit the cell; no slash trail or projectile.
HIT: body recoils with ears back and bent forelegs, recovers.
DEATH: knees buckle, rolls onto side, body settles, still side-lying wolf with tail/feet contained inside cell. No gore.

Redraw only that impact wolf slightly more compact: keep the biting head extended east, but tuck hind legs and curl tail inward so the ENTIRE silhouette is within global x420..580, y420..585. Its feet must remain at the same ground height.
Also keep the following EAST recovery pose (row3 column4, frame19) completely within global x630..775, y425..585; tuck its tail so it does not extend left into the impact cell. There MUST be a completely empty transparent vertical gap at least 20px wide between these two wolves. No fragment from one pose may enter the other. Preserve real four-legged wolf anatomy, four paws, long snout, ears, fur and bushy tail.
Do not add new poses or remove a frame. No resampling/downsampling, blur, background, shadow, text, borders, effects or grid. Return only the corrected transparent atlas.
